purpose: Disclose to the Indian Patent Office the particulars of corresponding applications for the same or substantially the same invention filed outside India, and undertake to keep the Controller informed in writing of such foreign filings up to the date of grant.

fee.note: No fee note is printed on the face of Form 3.

layout.notes: Two-column table: left column carries the numbered row label (section.title); right column carries the ordered boilerplate + input fields. Renderer should lay each section as one row with the title in the left column and the fields flowing in the right column. Inline fields sharing a presentation.group belong on the same line as the surrounding boilerplate.

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single applicant, 'We' for multiple, from the applicant count in uploaded documents. This choice recurs verbatim throughout the form (later 'I/We' occurrences are static text struck consistently per the global strike-out note).

sections.title: 2. Name, address and nationality of the joint applicant.
sections.description: On the official form the left-column label (2) reads 'Name, address and nationality of the joint applicant', but the right-column content is the Section 8 foreign-filing declarations (i)-(iii). Preserve the printed label; the fields below are the actual right-column content.

fields.text: (i) that I/We who have made the application for patent number

validation.patternMessage: Expected an IPO application number, e.g. 201811000123 or 1234/DEL/2015.

autofill.derivation: 'alone' for a single applicant; 'jointly with' when co-applicants exist.

fields.label: Foreign-filing declaration (choose one)
fields.description: Items (ii) and (iii) are the two mutually exclusive declarations, printed one after the other separated by 'Or'. Selecting 'some' (iii) requires at least one row in the foreign applications table below.

options.label: (ii) that I/We have not made any application for the same/substantially the same invention outside India
(iii) that I/We have made for the same/ substantially same invention, application(s) for patent in the other countries, the particulars of which are given below:

autofill.derivation: Select '(iii) some' if any foreign / PCT / priority documents were uploaded; otherwise '(ii) none'. User confirms.

fields.label: same / substantially the same
fields.description: Resolves the 'same/substantially the same' token embedded in the selected declaration (ii) or (iii).

fields.label: Particulars of corresponding applications filed in other countries

constraints.message: At least one foreign application must be listed when declaration (iii) is selected.

sections.title: 3. Name and address of the assignee
sections.description: Left-column label (3) reads 'Name and address of the assignee', but the right column contains the optional assignment declaration (i), the mandatory Section 8 undertaking (ii), and the date of the statement.

fields.text: (i) that the rights in the application(s) filed in India

fields.label: Name and address of the assignee
fields.description: Optional. If the rights have not been assigned, this entire declaration (i) line is struck out (see the global 'Strike out whichever is not applicable' note).

fields.text: (ii) that I/We undertake that upto the date of grant of the patent by the Controller, I/We would keep him informed in writing regarding the details of corresponding applications for patents filed outside India in accordance with the provisions contained in section 8 and rule 12.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: 4. To be signed by the applicant or his authorized registered patent agent.
5. Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the applicant's address or the office recorded on Form 1.

notes: Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable.
Declarations (ii) and (iii) in Section 2 are mutually exclusive (the 'foreign_status' radio enforces a single choice). Selecting (iii) requires at least one row in the foreign applications table.
Section 8 imposes a continuing duty to keep the Controller informed of foreign filings up to the date of grant; Form 3 may need to be re-filed when new foreign applications are made.

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: STATEMENT AND UNDERTAKING UNDER SECTION 8

metadata.rendererNotes: The header block (formTitle / statute / subject / citation) is provided under metadata.printedHeader so a renderer can reproduce the centred header exactly. See the schema-refinement notes accompanying this reference implementation: a first-class legalReference.citation (the '(See section.../rule...)' line) and an optional field-level 'printed' flag would let this move out of metadata.
